lead.title: AMD Launches Helios Rack-Scale AI System With MI455X GPU and 6th Gen EPYC Venice, Signs OpenAI and Anthropic as Customers
lead.summary: At Advancing AI 2026, AMD unveiled Helios — a rack-scale AI solution packing 72 MI455X GPUs (2nm, 432GB HBM4 each) and 18 EPYC Venice CPUs rated at 2.9 exaflops FP4 inference. OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Microsoft, and Oracle are confirmed customers. AMD separately announced a strategic partnership with Anthropic to deploy up to 2GW of MI450-series GPUs and a $5B equity investment.

top_stories.title: AI chip startup Etched raises $300M Series C at $10.3B valuation
top_stories.summary: Sequoia-led round with a16z, Jane Street, SK hynix; $1B in booked inference chip orders positions Etched as a major ASIC challenger.

top_stories.title: xAI Launches Workflows in Grok Build — Parallel Agent Orchestration at Scale
top_stories.summary: Grok Build can now fan out tasks across up to 1,024 parallel agents, verify results, and report back in one background run using plain-language workflows saved as slash commands.

top_stories.title: SemiAnalysis: Vera Rubin NVL72 Delivers 5.4x More Tokens Per MW Than GB200
top_stories.summary: Running DeepSeek R1, NVIDIA's Vera Rubin achieves 5.4x more tokens per megawatt and 5x more per dollar vs GB200 NVL72, with a $3.57/GPU-hour TCO that makes it the only viable option for serving workloads at 350 tok/s/user.

items.title: Google achieves quantum self-correction breakthrough — computers that retune themselves mid-computation
items.summary: Google's quantum system learns from its own errors and retunes itself mid-computation, beating expert calibration and reaching record error rates without human intervention.

items.title: Chinese labs face sanctions allegations over industrial-scale Kimi K-3 model distillation
items.summary: Analysis covers investor fears about cheaper models undercutting OpenAI and Anthropic, circular financing risks, runaway CapEx, and inference bottlenecks.

items.title: Apple preparing full Mac lineup overhaul to meet surging AI demand
items.summary: Apple plans new versions of every Mac across fall 2026 and 2027, targeting demand for powerful AI-capable laptops and desktops across iMac, MacBook Pro, and MacBook Air lines.

items.title: CoreWeave benchmarks NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72: 10x tokens per megawatt vs Grace Blackwell
items.summary: First published benchmarks on DeepSeek R1 show 10x more throughput per megawatt compared to GB200 NVL72 at matched interactivity, a critical metric for power-constrained AI factories.

items.title: AMD Launches Kria AI SOM and Robotics Developer Platform for Physical AI
items.summary: Industry's first open, fully integrated robotics platform combining Ryzen AI Embedded X100 (16 Zen 5 cores, RDNA 3.5 GPU, dedicated NPU) on a compact COM-HPC module for autonomous machines.

items.title: AMD Debuts Next-Generation AI Infrastructure for Frontier Models and Agentic Workloads
items.summary: Full coverage of AMD's Advancing AI 2026 announcements including Helios, MI455X GPU, 6th Gen EPYC Venice on 2nm, and Kria robotics platform with OpenAI CEO Sam Altman joining Lisa Su on stage.

items.title: Runway Launches Media Router — AI model selector by cost, speed, or quality
items.summary: Runway's new tool automatically selects the best image, video, or audio generation model based on developer priorities, routing across the crowded generative media landscape.

items.title: Echo delivers Fable-level quality at one-third the cost using open-weight models
items.summary: An adaptive model built from a pool of open-weight models (GLM-5.2, Kimi K2.7, and others) that dynamically routes to the most cost-effective open model for each task.

items.title: PromptQL — multiplayer AI workspace from the Hasura team aims to replace Slack
items.summary: An AI-native team workspace where shared threads replace channels, capturing tribal knowledge across databases, SaaS apps, and coding agents into a self-building business wiki.

items.title: OpenCode Superapp — Codex with local self-hosted models and voice interaction
items.summary: Unified coding assistant combining OpenAI Codex with local models for online and offline use with model flexibility.

items.title: OneCLI — open-source credential gateway keeping secrets out of AI agents
items.summary: Intercepts API keys before they reach AI agents, providing secure access to services without exposing credentials in context or logs.

items.title: Insurance startup Corgi reportedly raises B2 extension at $4B valuation
items.summary: Third round in 8 weeks for the AI-powered insurance startup backed by TCV and Kindred Ventures, with $450M ARR run-rate projected.

items.title: AegisAI lands $36M Series A to stop AI-driven spear phishing
items.summary: Led by Battery Ventures with Accel and Foundation Capital; founded by former Google security executives.

items.title: Ropedia raises $30M pre-A for physical AI data infrastructure
items.summary: Real-world multimodal training data for robotics and embodied AI via the HOMIE wearable system, with 10M interaction episodes and 10K hours of recordings.

items.title: Elio raises $21M for AI-native sensing and perception sensors
items.summary: Dynamic optical layers with AI correction for microscopy, semiconductor inspection, robotics, and defense applications.

items.title: Prosper Medical raises $16M seed for AI-powered concierge primary care
items.summary: AI-powered primary care platform from the former PlushCare team, in-network with major insurance carriers.
